title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 21: Showed Up Anyway

scenes.say: Ali reads his book to fifth graders. Even soldiers cry. And that's okay.
scenes.visual: a man reading a book to a classroom of young kids, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: A small boy raises his hand. Were you scared?
scenes.visual: a small hand raised in a classroom, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Every day. But I showed up anyway.
scenes.visual: kids listening on a classroom rug, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: A hospital parking lot. A wounded vet in a wheelchair. They all forgot me. Not me.
scenes.visual: two men shaking hands in a hospital parking lot at dusk, one in a wheelchair, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Real soldiers never leave one behind, even when the battle's over.
scenes.visual: a wheelchair silhouette against a sunset, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Dinner with his mother and sister. Laughter flows.
scenes.visual: a family dinner table with laughter, warm light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: You really here for good this time? Yeah, Ma. I'm home.
scenes.visual: glasses of iced tea clinking over a dinner table, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: A memorial wall. Ali traces Roddy's engraved name.
scenes.visual: a finger tracing an engraved name on a memorial wall, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Some names live forever. Not 'cause they lived long, but 'cause they lived right.
scenes.visual: dog tags left beside a name on a memorial wall, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Twenty Two. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a memorial wall at sunrise, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 21 of 25: Showed Up Anyway. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
